stories.title: Abu Dhabi trilateral talks end without breakthrough, POW exchange planned
stories.summary: Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the United States concluded after a second day without any breakthrough on ending the war. The American side said it saw “some openings”, but no concrete agreement was reached to halt the nearly five‑year conflict sparked by Russia’s invasion. Moscow and Kyiv said a large‑scale prisoner‑of‑war exchange is being prepared and could be carried out soon.
stories.why: The stalemate shows diplomatic progress remains limited, while a POW exchange could improve humanitarian conditions for those captured.

stories.title: British AI chip startup Fractile raises $720 million Series C
stories.summary: Fractile, a UK‑based AI‑chip developer, announced a $720 million Series C round led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Redpoint, with participation from Britain’s Sovereign AI Fund. The financing values the company at over £5 billion (roughly $7 billion) and supports its full‑stack approach that pairs a machine‑learning compiler with a DRAM‑stacked chip design aimed at lowering inference costs.
stories.why: The funding strengthens the UK’s position in AI‑hardware development and may speed the deployment of more cost‑effective AI inference solutions.

stories.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
stories.summary: Before those challenges even come into play, though, there’s a more basic problem: A lot of the projects being announced may never get built in the first place.
